status: Reassessment for Tom; no implementation approved
answer: Previous recommendation addressed the editor, not the full frequent-task entry path. Revise around direct, always-visible Videos-row assignment with the full editor retained for detailed management.

references.observed: A focused Assign staff to project dialog separates Add staff from an Assigned list.
references.relevance: Separate choosing someone from reviewing existing assignments.
references.limit: This screen does not show production-role capacity, Freelancer project fees or pending invitations. Its Done label does not establish Brisk save semantics.

references.observed: The task editor has a compact assignee picker with Unassigned, existing people, Invite new team member and Add assignee to workspace entries.
references.relevance: Keep existing-person selection distinct from bringing someone new into the team.
references.limit: Simple task assignment; it does not show Brisk’s richer rate/capacity decision. It is not evidence to replace the whole role editor with a dropdown.

references.observed: Add Project Members puts member selection and member role first, with a collapsed Set billable rates section above Add members.
references.relevance: Reduce the visual competition between the main selection task and secondary detail.
references.limit: Billable rates are a different financial concept from Brisk Freelancer project fees. Keep Brisk rates visible when they inform the choice; do not copy the collapse mechanically.

references.observed: A focused assignment dialog has a name/email search field, selected people and an explicit Assign button.
references.relevance: Search, a visible choice and an explicit action can sit together in a compact editor.
references.limit: Managed event assignment, not production staffing. Brisk’s multi-person invitations and single-person direct assignment still need their own rules.

revisedDirection.proposal: Keep a focused role editor. Make role hours compact, then show Staff/Freelancers and the person-selection area before the full invitation-management list.
revisedDirection.basis: Reference-informed composition judgement; current Brisk invitations occupy substantial space before the people chooser.
revisedDirection.tradeoff: Existing invitation count and status summary must remain visible, because assignment can affect outstanding invitations.

revisedDirection.proposal: Provide search within the person chooser. Keep useful suggestions, but fall back to the full current-role group when the suggested set is empty, with a visible All Staff or All Freelancers scope label.
revisedDirection.basis: Search is directly visible in the inspected Calendly reference. Empty-shortlist fallback is a Brisk product judgement, replacing TP03’s copy-only repair if approved.
revisedDirection.tradeoff: This changes initial filtering. Preserve disabled people/reasons, selections and a visible selected count when search hides selected people. Search wording and the fallback require explicit agreement.

revisedDirection.proposal: Show existing invitations as a compact, separate section with a count and status summary. Expand it to inspect existing details and withdrawal controls.
revisedDirection.basis: Reference-informed separation of current state from new selection; this exact invitation disclosure is a Brisk judgement.
revisedDirection.tradeoff: Adds a step to inspect full invitation details. Preserve the warning/confirmation boundaries when assignment affects active invitations; do not hide the existence of pending invitations.

revisedDirection.proposal: Retain the original DS Checkbox repair and visible Project rate heading. Keep Staff capacity, Freelancer rates, independent inputs, deselection, multi-selection and separate Assign / Assign now / Invite meanings.
revisedDirection.basis: Brisk’s approved component standard and current workflow requirements remain authoritative.
revisedDirection.tradeoff: The richer rows need more space than a simple task dropdown; that space supports the staffing decision.

originalProposal: TP01 and TP02 still recommended. TP03 is the smaller fallback; proposed TR02 changes the default list and needs agreement.
limits: Inspected examples support patterns, not proof of one best design or measured usability outcomes.
No inspected example covers Brisk’s full combination of capacity, role hours, project fees and pending Freelancer invitations.
Other searches returned access administration, calendar availability or assignee filters. Those were inspected but not used as assignment references.
Mobbin references support structural decisions only and do not replace approved Brisk DS styling or permission rules.
scope: Audit artefacts only. No application code, records, settings or permissions changed.

latestRequirement.status: User requirement recorded; revised proposal, no implementation approval
latestRequirement.requirement: Frequent assignment must be directly discoverable from each Videos project row, with the minimum meaningful steps and no need to hunt through details or enable columns.

sourceEvidence.defaultTeamColumn: Hidden by default; optional Team cell opens the Team panel rather than a role picker.
sourceEvidence.projectQuickActions: Current project-name quick actions include Chat, Files where available, and Client portal; no direct labelled assignment action.

latestRequirement.assessment: The previous editor-focused proposal did not fully address the entry path.
latestRequirement.proposedEntry: Always-visible Assign team action in the leading project identity area. Available in normal desktop row layout, without hover, overflow menu, horizontal scrolling or column configuration. Preserve Staff-only management rights.
latestRequirement.proposedQuickFlow: Open assignment directly from Videos. Show role and required hours at the top; show person choices with Staff capacity or Freelancer hourly rate/project cost. Review hours/cost and choose person before the distinct Assign or Invite action. Search is optional.

clickTarget.knownRole: Open chooser > choose person > Assign:3 clicks.
clickTarget.roleNeeded: Open chooser > choose role > choose person > Assign:4 clicks.
clickTarget.limit: 3/4-click targets apply only when role and prefilled required hours are already correct. Editing required hours is a necessary additional interaction, and must not be removed to meet a click count. Preserve Freelancer rate/terms and pending-invitation safeguards.

latestRequirement.detailedManagement: Retain full Team management for invitation history, withdrawal and broader role settings. Required hours is part of quick assignment, not confined to detailed management.
latestRequirement.preserve: Person selection is still distinct from assignment; invitations remain distinct from direct assignment. No new Undo or autosave behaviour is implied.
latestRequirement.notApproved: Control placement, compact chooser composition and role-selection defaults remain proposals requiring agreement.

requiredHours.priority: Essential part of quick assignment, explicitly requested by Tom.
requiredHours.placement: Visible and editable alongside the role at the top of the quick chooser, before Assign or Invite. Do not move it behind detailed management.
requiredHours.initialValue: Prefill existing role hours when available; allow review/edit without unnecessary retyping. Preserve current hours rules.
requiredHours.cost: Show the Freelancer hourly rate and calculated project cost together. Hours changes update the calculated estimate. Preserve and clearly identify existing custom/agreed project-rate overrides; never silently replace them.
requiredHours.source: RoleEditorModal.tsx:getProjectRateValue uses hourly rate times role hours unless a project-rate override exists.

hoursClarification: Required hours must be visible/editable in quick assignment and explain Freelancer cost. Earlier wording placing role hours only in detailed management is superseded.
